title: Container mode: chown the claude-code-config volume to HOST_UID + re-assert bypass flag in ensure-up (CAM-175 blocker)
description: CAM-175 live ceremony (2026-07-04, v0.59.0) found container mode non-functional for real workers due to a single root cause with two symptoms. ROOT CAUSE: the named docker volume claude-code-config mounts root-owned (0:0, 755) at /home/bun/.claude (src/supervisor/worker-container.ts:217), shadowing the dir that the Dockerfile chown -R re-owned at build time (a runtime volume mount always covers the build-time dir). CONSEQUENCE 1: claude (uid 501 bun) cannot mkdir /home/bun/.claude/session-env -> every worker Bash tool call fails EACCES -> the implementer cannot run git/gates. CONSEQUENCE 2: unable to persist accept-state to the root-owned dir, claude rewrites /home/bun/.claude.json and DROPS bypassPermissionsModeAccepted (baked true by CAM-179 becomes null), so the interactive Bypass Permissions modal reappears and hangs the worker at a 1/2 accept prompt. FIX VALIDATED LIVE: docker exec -u root chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude + re-assert bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true in .claude.json -> a fresh dispatch skipped the modal (modal-lines 0), ran bash with zero EACCES, ran typecheck ok, committed + pushed the story from inside the container. PROPOSED FIX: in the ensure-up container path (alongside the CAM-176 firewall apply, after ensureWorkerContainer and before dispatch): (1) chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude to un-shadow the root-owned volume, (2) defensively re-assert bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true (and the 5 CAM-179 keys) in /home/bun/.claude.json since claude strips the baked value on rewrite. Idempotent, mirrors the firewall wiring pattern. SECONDARY OBSERVATIONS (file follow-ups if they reproduce): (a) in-container bun test showed 2957 pass / 10 fail vs 3012 green on host; confirm whether the 10 are container-env-specific; (b) the container image has no jq (worker fell back to bunx/python); consider installing jq in the Dockerfile since agent scripts assume it. This is the CAM-175 definitive-gate blocker: container mode is otherwise verified GREEN end-to-end (firewall converges, egress allow anthropic+github / block example.com, /workspace writable + round-trip, story GREEN in-container).
